The billing idempotency race fix is committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race` (3 files, 19 insertions, 4 deletions). Invoice pagination and invoice-summary optimization remain validated but uncommitted and should be kept as separate small commits. Pagination adds a dictionary envelope and metadata with comprehensive edge-case coverage; all 18 tests, Ruff, and whitespace checks pass. Summary reporting reduced tenant 73 from 2,417 queries/38.6s to 37 queries/~4.3s with a stable regression assertion; 18 focused and 63 broader tests pass (2 PostgreSQL skips), along with Ruff and whitespace checks.

- Uses shared `ledgerly.billing.money.format_money()` for locale-aware grouping instead of duplicated decimal conversion.
- Centralizes point-to-inch row-height conversion.
- Reserves repeated table-header space once per document, fixing inconsistent page wrapping.

- `83 passed, 4 skipped` for the broader billing suite
- Existing golden PDFs remained byte-stable.
- No Ruff or whitespace errors; diff currently reports four changed files, 217 insertions, 184 deletions.
